recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Any future change to the examples or document-scope wording should be handled as a new work-group decision because the current source already reflects the published FHIR-38933 decision.
issue_request: FHIR-38933 was a Published/Persuasive R5 FHIR-I clarification asking the FHIR Documents introduction to read more naturally by saying documents may serve clinical and non-clinical purposes, and by adding examples for other non-clinical documents.
initial_application: Commit d7563bf03921e97c6a4569038ec83ac7f9451688 explicitly applied FHIR-38933 to source/documents.html, replacing the older "may be 'clinical'" paragraph with the current clinical/non-clinical-purpose wording and adding "Death Certificate" and "Medication Registration Information" as examples of other non-clinical documents.
additional_context: source/documents.html is in build scope through source/hierarchy.xml. FHIR-35830 was an earlier same-paragraph clarification that removed FHIR Implementation Guides as an example and broadened the paragraph before FHIR-38933 refined it. FHIR-I minutes from 2023-02-06 record the FHIR-38933 11-0-0 Persuasive vote. Later editorial punctuation work preserved the FHIR-38933 text, and Zulip searches found no direct FHIR-38933 discussion or conflicting community guidance.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the combined branch already contains the wording and examples requested by FHIR-38933. An empty audit commit was published to record that decision.
